breakdown.description: The prompt describes a turbulent flow but sets the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero. This is physically incorrect and will prevent turbulence from developing correctly from the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly fixed both k and omega inlet values. Instead of the erroneous 'uniform 0' for both, the agent set k to 'fixedValue uniform 1.5' and omega to 'fixedValue uniform 447.2', which match the ground truth values computed from the given turbulence intensity (5%) and mixing length (0.005 m).
